whatThisPluginAdds.text: Audio Playlist adds a Layout Builder widget for local audio tracks with artwork, native controls, transcripts, and chapter markers. Its configuration accepts a bounded playlist and rejects remote audio sources.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors configure the playlist in Layout Builder, and visitors receive a public player with track context and supporting transcript or chapter content when supplied.

developers.text: The package registers a typed widget extension and validates media and nested track data before the public Blade render.

teams.text: Teams can publish a structured listening experience with useful context instead of assembling separate players and transcript blocks.
